And before anyone asks, I am not rich, my parents grew up in poverty. I consider my to self to be sucessful, at least for my age, and generally have strong moral values (don't drink, party, am a virgin, etc) and am looking for a partner who shares similar values. All my friends know this. So a friend of mine M27, tried to set me up with a mechanic he knows, despite her being not a virgin and obviously being less successful (nothing against tradespeople, I just want someone with similar levels of success) He kept pushing this, saying that since she was a "good person", it is somehow a fair deal (even though he considers me to be a "good person" so therefore he doesn't know how to balance a scale").
